Every day our nation loses 17 veterans to suicide. We must do more to help these heroes heal from their invisible wounds.

Today, I spoke in support an NDAA amendment I've championed, led by @RepLuttrell, to expand veterans' access to neuroplastogen treatments like ibogaine.
posts.summary: Advocates expanding veterans' access to neuroplastogen treatments for suicide prevention

posts.text: As Chairman of the Special Events Task Force, I am proud to declare the 2026 World Cup a massive success! Securing 11 cities, 48 teams, and over 6.5 million fans is no easy task. I'd like to congratulate all federal, state, and local law enforcement entities, the @WHTaskForceFIFA, and my @HomelandGOP colleagues on their hard work to ensure the games were safe and fun for all.
